sample_unit: patients with prostate cancer discussed at multidisciplinary tumor board

links.outcome: Concordance of guideline bot recommendations with tumor board decisions, including omissions of genetic testing and diagnostic steps
links.effect: 74.3% complete concordance; 89.7% clinically acceptable (levels 1–2); 39 cases with discrepancy, including omitted genetic testing (10.3%) and omitted diagnostic or restaging steps (10.3%).
links.quote: Complete concordance was observed in 74.3% of cases, while 89.7% were considered clinically acceptable (levels 1–2).

screen.reason: Prospective study evaluating the concordance of the EAU Guidelines Bot with actual multidisciplinary tumor board decisions for prostate cancer cases, testing decision-support performance without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
